text:
# Pre-market brief, Mon 2026-10-26 (as of ~8:20 AM ET)

1. **Futures modestly higher as oil eases.** S&P and Nasdaq-100 futures +0.3%, Dow +0.5% at 6:06 ET ([Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/premarket-movers-moderna-brazil-adrs-drop-spacex-rises-4972193)); crude down as a Saudi/Turkey/Pakistan delegation meets in Tehran ([Newsquawk](https://www.newsquawk.com/daily/5827-us-market-open-crude-benchmarks-move-lower-which-is-lifting-sentiment-across-us-equity-futures-oats-outperform-post-moodys); [Reuters](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/us-stock-futures-edge-up-as-oil-falls-heading-into-earnings-barrage-4971878)). De-escalation risk for our energy/defense holds (HAL, SLB, XLE, LMT, RTX).
2. **Rates flat-high:** 10y 4.99%, 2y 4.70%, 30y 5.31% ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/26/us-treasury-yields-investors-feds-interest-rate-decision-.html)). Gold back near $4,000 after a 25%+ drawdown ([X News](https://x.com/i/trending/2114391218142556244)). BTC: not verified.
3. **VZ beat-and-raise:** adj EPS $1.31 vs $1.28, 406k postpaid phone adds (~2x est.), FY EPS guide $5.04–5.06, $2B+ AWS fiber deal; revenue missed ($34.3B vs $34.7B); +0.7% to +2.4% pre ([Reuters](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/verizon-lifts-annual-forecasts-signs-more-than-2-billion-ai-infrastructure-deal-with-aws-4972134); [Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/earnings/verizon-beats-profit-estimates-raises-guidance-4972194)).
4. **Movers:** MRNA −9.3% (Phase 3 melanoma data below Phase 2b); SpaceX +1.1% on $40B GPU debt financing, Musk warns 200+ neoclouds face failures (keeps AI-infra avoid); FICO −4.5% on Wells downgrade ([Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/premarket-movers-moderna-brazil-adrs-drop-spacex-rises-4972193)). TSLA ~$379 pre on Barclays upgrade to OW, PT $450 ([X News](https://x.com/i/trending/2114671982172336183)).
5. **Anthropic S-1** expected 9 AM ET, possible IPO Nov 19–20 ([X News](https://x.com/i/trending/2114676296202756531)); AI-sentiment read-through.

## Week ahead ([TD](https://economics.td.com/domains/economics.td.com/documents/reports/bottom-line/tables/2026-10-23/upcoming.htm), [StockHub](https://stockhub.kr/en/insights/macro-weekly-20261026))
- Mon: CDNS AMC. Tue: durable goods 8:30, Conf. Board confidence and new home sales 10:00; KO, UPS, PYPL BMO; V, HOOD AMC.
- Wed: FOMC 2:00 PM (hold expected, 88% per FedWatch, [Kiplinger](https://www.kiplinger.com/investing/economy/this-weeks-economic-calendar)); MSFT, GOOGL, NOW, TMUS AMC.
- Thu: Q3 GDP + Sep PCE 8:30, ECB; LLY, CAT BMO; AMZN, INTC AMC.
- Fri: ECI 8:30; XOM BMO.

## Swing ideas
- **VZ** long, low. Clean beat-and-raise, small gap (fits our beat-and-raise lesson). Risk: SpaceX carrier threat keeps telco group heavy; TMUS reports Wed.
